The file `sys/arch/rp2040/dev/flash_swap.c` implements a flash swap algorithm that rewrites a program page through a spare sector. It uses a program-page-aligned range, copying untouched pages to the destination while overwriting the destination with the source. The swap is performed without erasing the entire SRAM, relying instead on block-rewrite semantics.

Key functions include `flash_swap_append` for appending a new page, `flash_swap_rewrite` for rewriting a range, and internal checks for valid offset and length. The algorithm ensures pages are overwritten only when necessary, avoiding unnecessary erase operations.

The design separates geometry from the flash driver, allowing host testing against a NOR model that rejects 0-to-1 bit transitions. It handles padding with erased bytes and overwrites only when the destination is erased, preserving block-rewrite semantics.
